account_scope.target_priority: ordered index starting at one within a platform
account_scope.platform_isolation: each platform has an independent version, item list, and last task

request_contract.idempotency: request_id plus platform, exact ordered ids, expected version, and client id
request_contract.legacy: a POST without schema=2 is rejected with client_upgrade_required
request_contract.details_zero: GET task with schema=2 and details=0 omits items

task_contract.waiting_reason: always a string; empty when no account is waiting
task_contract.waiting_account_ids: account ids currently blocked by a lease

recovery_contract.dispatched_applied: verify observed target after restart without another upstream write
recovery_contract.dispatched_unapplied: record observed mismatch and finish needs_confirmation without replay
recovery_contract.pending_remaining: continue never-dispatched items exactly once after restart
